summary: The J. David Gladstone Institutes' Mission Bay headquarters at 1650 Owens Street: a six-story, roughly 200,000-sq-ft biomedical research building for this independent nonprofit research organization (in academic partnership with UCSF), dedicated in December 2004. The expansion of the six-story building from 200,000 to 275,000 sq ft (about 75,000 sq ft added, around $160 million) was announced in February 2023, with construction then expected to start in late 2024 and finish by 2026; whether it was built is not confirmed. In March 2026 Gladstone announced more than 105,000 sq ft of future lab space in a new building at 1450 Owens Street, opening in early 2027.

milestones.text: The Gladstone Institute's new Mission Bay building, across Owens Street from the neighboring Building 23B parking structure, is reported 'now under construction' in a UC Regents budget item for that garage, which notes UCSF's agreement to accommodate the Institute with 240 parking spaces
Gladstone Institutes dedicate their new Mission Bay research building

A roughly $160M expansion at 1650 Owens Street, growing the six-story building from 200,000 to 275,000 sq ft (about 75,000 sq ft added), is announced; construction was then expected to start in late 2024 and finish by 2026, and whether it was built is not confirmed

costs.what: SF Department of Building Inspection permit #200208194343's revised construction-cost valuation for the original 6-story office/laboratory building at 1650 Owens St (the permit's initial filed estimate was $14,000,000); no Gladstone- or UCSF-stated project budget was found. The permit's own completed_date (2005-10-28) postdates Gladstone's December 2004 dedication -- likely reflects administrative permit closeout rather than the building's actual completion.

open_questions: Exact dedication day within December 2004 not sourced; only the month is confirmed.

Status of the expansion announced in 2023 (200,000 to 275,000 sq ft at 1650 Owens) was not confirmed: it was reported as expected to finish by 2026, but Gladstone's own March 25, 2026 release describes new lab space at 1450 Owens Street (opening early 2027) and says space will become available at 1650 Owens when two institutes relocate; it does not say the 1650 Owens expansion was built. Re-check before relying on either.
Architect and construction cost of the original 2004 building: no source found as of 2026-09-21.

The November 2003 Regents item mentioning Gladstone as 'now under construction' is about a neighboring parking-garage project, not Gladstone's own budget or design approval -- it corroborates a construction-in-progress date but is not Gladstone's own Regents record (Gladstone is a UCSF-affiliated independent nonprofit, not a Regents capital project, so no Regents budget/design item for it was expected or searched for beyond this passing mention).

As of 2026-09-29: the ~105,000 sq ft figure earlier attached to the 1650 Owens expansion is the size of the 1450 Owens lease announced in March 2026, not the expansion at 1650 Owens (about 75,000 sq ft per SF YIMBY, 2023). UCSF's December 2004 dedication page could not be checked; Gladstone's own 2026 release says the 1650 Owens building has served as its headquarters 'since 2004', which supports the year but not the month.
